products.name: GPT-3
products.description: A large-scale language model capable of generating human-like text.

products.name: GPT-4
products.description: A more advanced version of GPT-3 with improved capabilities in reasoning, coding, and other tasks.

products.name: DALL·E
products.description: An AI system that generates images from text descriptions.

products.name: Codex
products.description: An AI system that generates code from natural language descriptions.
